scope: New release delivery contract, mandatory AGENTS entry, templates, short workflow link, task report/navigation/evidence and directly referenced existing tool interfaces only.

actualToolInterfaceChecks.scopePlanCli: --base <commit> --head <commit> exists; package release:plan maps to it; docs/ and AGENTS paths are non-production
actualToolInterfaceChecks.batchCli: prepare, inspect, execute, status exist; no reconcile subcommand
actualToolInterfaceChecks.reconciliation: export reconcileOperation binds exact batch/operation/independent proof/noReplay and appends original WAL under lock; documentation now distinguishes read-only evidence from mutating coordination
actualToolInterfaceChecks.closeoutInput: batchPath, approvedSha256, journalDirectory are read; optional batchFileSha256 and evidence/receipt references match template
actualToolInterfaceChecks.closeoutWal: complete sequential canonical original WAL chain, event hashes and original receipt-operation binding are checked
actualToolInterfaceChecks.closeoutOutput: new directory report.json, REPORT.md, evidence-manifest.json; always draft=true and acceptancePassed=null
actualToolInterfaceChecks.legacyStandaloneReceipts: retain original format and use task worksheet; no invented batch/WAL or backfilled historical started events
actualToolInterfaceChecks.closeoutSideEffects: no production queries, batch closure, Git push or worktree archive is implied or performed by the report generator
actualToolInterfaceChecks.privatePreparationReuse: 10 minute/24 use in-memory identity derivation is not an ACL/process/restore/artifact-success cache
actualToolInterfaceChecks.readonlyRetry: classified read-only observations only; no lifecycle or business replay

findings.trigger: An agent treats the originally described read-only coordination as observation-only.
findings.evidence: tools/release-batch.mjs:534 reconcileOperation returns append(state,batch,...) within the lock, writing the original journal.
findings.impact: Could misstate a mutating WAL reconciliation as a read-only action and obscure the original protocol/authorization boundary.
findings.minimalFix: Say independent read-only evidence and original exact coordination; explicitly state that coordination may write the original audit/WAL.
findings.resolution: Coordinator made that exact wording change. Independent incremental review confirmed it in the final report; no tool or production change was requested.

verification.independentReviewMethod: Complete direct documentation diff and proposal review; read-only source/interface and archived-evidence inspection; static links/anchors, JSON, byte digests and documentation scope checks.

limits: This passes the document contract and templates for delivery; it does not establish a 15 minute production result.
No new runtime enforcement, recovery protocol, adapter, cache or pipeline was implemented or adopted.
Future production actions still require their exact authorization, installed capability, original dynamic gates and evidence.
Archived successful targeted regressions were inspected and reused, not rerun or relabeled as reviewer-executed tests.
Original failed dependency-loading log remains failed and distinct from later passing logs.
postReviewMetadataBoundary: contract-document-check.json is a coordinator summary whose review-output-present field is finalized after this file exists. Its non-core summary metadata is deliberately outside frozen review-input hashes; no self-reference hash loop is required.
